_doc: Config + USER marks for scripts/artifact_queue.py (docs/design/artifact-staleness-queue.md). Workers read this file from origin's branch tip, so commit + push an edit for every machine to see it. marks: [{deck, kind: mulligan|valueleaf, why, priority, date}] -- a marked artifact sorts first regardless of measured drift (higher priority first). Set with `artifact_queue.py mark`. recipe_overrides: {deck: fast|complete} -- a USER override of the never-below-the-incumbent plan (mull_plan).
